notes:
=== CONCEPT ===
gvm-start launches all GVM/OpenVAS services: gvmd (manager daemon), ospd-openvas (scanner), gsad (web UI). Services must all be running before the web interface is accessible.

=== CHAINING ===
gvm-start → check gvm-check-setup for health → access web UI → create credentials (SSH/SMB for credentialed scans) → create targets → configure and run scans.

=== TROUBLESHOOTING ===
If web UI unreachable after start: check service status with systemctl. GVM services take 1-3 minutes to fully initialize. Check /var/log/gvm/ for errors.
